package gocql
	type gocql.Batch struct
		field Kind cql.BatchKind
		method (*T) Len() int
		method (*T) Reset()
	type gocql.CASBatchRows[X any] struct
		method (T) Applied() (bool, error)
		method (T) Clone() (cql.CASResult[X], error)
		method (T) Close() error
		method (T) Columns() cql.Columns
		method (T) Err() error
		method (T) Info() gocql.Result
		method (T) NextInto(dst *cql.CASResult[X]) bool
		method (T) Retain() (*gocql.PageLease, error)
	type gocql.CQLTraceRef = cql.CQLTraceRef
		field ID cql.UUID
		field HostID cql.UUID
		field Attempt int
		field Failed bool
		field Speculative bool
	type gocql.CassandraV4 struct
	type gocql.CassandraV5 struct
	func gocql.Connect[D gocql.Dialect](ctx context.Context, cfg config.Config) (*gocql.Session[D], error)
	type gocql.Dialect interface (sealed)
	const gocql.MaxBatchStatements untyped int
	type gocql.Page[R any] struct
		method (*T) Clone() (R, error)
		method (*T) Close() error
		method (*T) Columns() cql.Columns
		method (*T) Err() error
		method (*T) Info() gocql.Result
		method (*T) NextInto(dst *R) bool
		method (*T) Retain() (*gocql.PageLease, error)
		method (*T) State() cql.PageState
	type gocql.PageLease struct
		method (*T) Close()
	type gocql.Prepared[P any, R any] struct
		method (*T) AddToBatch(batch *gocql.Batch, value P) error
		method (*T) All(ctx context.Context, value P, dst *R, options ...exec.CompiledOptions) iter.Seq2[*R, error]
		method (*T) Columns() cql.Columns
		method (*T) Each(ctx context.Context, value P, dst *R, fn func(*R) error, options ...exec.CompiledOptions) (gocql.Result, error)
		method (*T) Exec(ctx context.Context, value P, options ...exec.CompiledOptions) (gocql.Result, error)
		method (*T) Info() gocql.PreparedInfo
		method (*T) One(ctx context.Context, value P, dst *R, options ...exec.CompiledOptions) (bool, gocql.Result, error)
		method (*T) Parameters() cql.Columns
		method (*T) Query(options exec.Options) (*gocql.Query[P, R], error)
		method (*T) Run(ctx context.Context, value P, options ...exec.CompiledOptions) (gocql.Rows[R], error)
		method (*T) RunPage(ctx context.Context, value P, state cql.PageState, pageSize int32, options ...exec.CompiledOptions) (*gocql.Page[R], error)
	type gocql.PreparedInfo = internal/session.PreparedInfo
		field Keyspace string
		field Table string
		field PartitionKeyIndexes []int
		field Kind cql.StatementKind
		field Conditional bool
		field Generation uint64
	type gocql.PreparedStream[P any, R any] struct
		method (*T) Columns() cql.Columns
		method (*T) Info() gocql.PreparedInfo
		method (*T) Parameters() cql.Columns
		method (*T) Query(options exec.StreamOptions) (*gocql.StreamQuery[P, R], error)
	type gocql.Query[P any, R any] struct
		method (*T) AddToBatch(batch *gocql.Batch, value P) error
		method (*T) All(ctx context.Context, value P, dst *R) iter.Seq2[*R, error]
		method (*T) Close()
		method (*T) Each(ctx context.Context, value P, dst *R, fn func(*R) error) (gocql.Result, error)
		method (*T) Exec(ctx context.Context, value P) (gocql.Result, error)
		method (*T) One(ctx context.Context, value P, dst *R) (bool, gocql.Result, error)
		method (*T) Routing(value P) (routing.Info, error)
		method (*T) Run(ctx context.Context, value P) (gocql.Rows[R], error)
		method (*T) RunPage(ctx context.Context, value P, state cql.PageState, pageSize int32) (*gocql.Page[R], error)
		method (*T) Wait(ctx context.Context) error
	type gocql.Result = cql.Result
		field HostID cql.UUID
		field Attempts int
		field Latency time.Duration
		field Rows int64
		field AchievedConsistency cql.Consistency
		method (*T) AddCQLTraces(traces ...cql.CQLTraceRef)
		method (*T) AddCustomPayload(entries ...cql.PayloadEntry)
		method (*T) AddWarnings(warnings ...string)
		method (T) CQLTraces() []cql.CQLTraceRef
		method (T) CustomPayload() []cql.PayloadEntry
		method (*T) SetDiagnostics(warnings []string, traces []cql.CQLTraceRef, customPayload []cql.PayloadEntry)
		method (T) Warnings() []string
	type gocql.RowStream[R any] struct
		method (*T) Close() error
		method (*T) Columns() cql.Columns
		method (*T) Err() error
		method (*T) Info() gocql.StreamInfo
		method (*T) NextInto(dst *R) bool
	type gocql.Rows[R any] struct
		method (T) Clone() (R, error)
		method (T) Close() error
		method (T) Columns() cql.Columns
		method (T) Err() error
		method (T) Info() gocql.Result
		method (T) NextInto(dst *R) bool
		method (T) Retain() (*gocql.PageLease, error)
	type gocql.ScyllaV4 struct
	type gocql.Session[D gocql.Dialect] struct
		method (*T) AwaitSchemaAgreement(ctx context.Context) error
		method (*T) Close() error
		method (*T) Closed() bool
		method (*T) CompileOptions(options exec.Options) (exec.CompiledOptions, error)
		method (*T) ExecBatch(ctx context.Context, batch *gocql.Batch, options ...exec.CompiledOptions) (gocql.Result, error)
		method (*T) ID() string
		method (*T) Metadata() *metadata.Snapshot
		method (*T) Metrics() metrics.Snapshot
		method (*T) Prepare[P, R any](ctx context.Context, statement cql.Statement[P, R], options ...exec.PrepareOptions) (*gocql.Prepared[P, R], error)
		method (*T) PrepareStream[P, R any](ctx context.Context, statement cql/stream.Statement[P, R], options ...exec.PrepareOptions) (*gocql.PreparedStream[P, R], error)
		method (*T) RefreshMetadata(ctx context.Context) error
		method (*T) RunBatch[R any](ctx context.Context, batch *gocql.Batch, decoder cql.RowDecoder[R], options ...exec.CompiledOptions) (gocql.Rows[R], error)
		method (*T) RunConditionalBatch[X any](ctx context.Context, batch *gocql.Batch, decoder cql.RowDecoder[cql.CASResult[X]], options ...exec.CompiledOptions) (gocql.CASBatchRows[X], error)
		method (*T) Subscribe(filter event.Filter) (*event.Subscription, error)
		method (*T) UnpreparedAddToBatch[P, R any](batch *gocql.Batch, statement cql.Statement[P, R], value P) error
		method (*T) UnpreparedAll[P, R any](ctx context.Context, statement cql.Statement[P, R], value P, dst *R, options ...exec.Options) iter.Seq2[*R, error]
		method (*T) UnpreparedEach[P, R any](ctx context.Context, statement cql.Statement[P, R], value P, dst *R, fn func(*R) error, options ...exec.Options) (gocql.Result, error)
		method (*T) UnpreparedExec[P any](ctx context.Context, statement cql.Statement[P, cql.EmptyRow], value P, options ...exec.Options) (gocql.Result, error)
		method (*T) UnpreparedOne[P, R any](ctx context.Context, statement cql.Statement[P, R], value P, dst *R, options ...exec.Options) (bool, gocql.Result, error)
	var gocql.StopIteration error
	type gocql.StreamInfo = internal/session.StreamInfo
		field Result cql.Result
		field DeliveredRows int64
		field Pages int64
		field OutputStarted bool
	type gocql.StreamQuery[P any, R any] struct
		method (*T) Close()
		method (*T) Run(ctx context.Context, value P) (*gocql.RowStream[R], error)
		method (*T) Wait(ctx context.Context) error

package auth
	type auth.Exchange = internal/connectivity.AuthExchange
		method Challenge(context.Context, internal/connectivity.Nullable[internal/connectivity.Bytes]) (internal/connectivity.Nullable[[]byte], error)
		method Close()
		method Success(context.Context, internal/connectivity.Nullable[internal/connectivity.Bytes]) error
	func auth.Password(username string, password string) auth.Provider
	type auth.Provider = internal/connectivity.AuthProvider
		method Start(context.Context, internal/connectivity.HostSnapshot, string) (internal/connectivity.AuthExchange, internal/connectivity.Nullable[[]byte], error)

package config
	type config.AttemptEvent = internal/routing.AttemptEvent
		field Started time.Time
		field Err error
		field RequestID uint64
		field Attempt int
		field Latency time.Duration
		field Target internal/routing.Target
		field CQLTraceID cql.Option[cql.UUID]
		field Cancelled bool
		field Speculative bool
	type config.AttemptStart = internal/routing.AttemptStart
		field Started time.Time
		field RequestID uint64
		field Attempt int
		field Target internal/routing.Target
		field Speculative bool
	type config.ClientRoute struct

		field Hostname string

	type config.Compression = cql.Compression
	type config.Config struct

		method (*T) NoSerialConsistency() *config.ProfileBuilder
		method (*T) NoTimeout() *config.ProfileBuilder

		method (*T) WithPageTimeout(d time.Duration) *config.ProfileBuilder
		method (*T) WithPrefetch(pages int) *config.ProfileBuilder
		method (*T) WithRetry(policy retry.Policy) *config.ProfileBuilder
		method (*T) WithRouting(policy routing.Policy) *config.ProfileBuilder
		method (*T) WithSerialConsistency(c cql.Consistency) *config.ProfileBuilder
		method (*T) WithSpeculation(policy config.SpeculationPolicy) *config.ProfileBuilder
		method (*T) WithTimeout(d time.Duration) *config.ProfileBuilder

package retry
	type retry.Action uint8
	type retry.Attempt struct
		field Err error
		field Number int
		field Idempotent bool
		field Consistency cql.Consistency
		field Conditional bool
		field BytesWritten bool
		field ExecutionStatus cqlerr.ExecutionStatus
	type retry.Decision struct
		field Action retry.Action
		field Consistency cql.Option[cql.Consistency]
		field Delay time.Duration
	const retry.IgnoreWrite retry.Action
	type retry.Never struct
		method (T) Decide(retry.Attempt) retry.Decision
	const retry.Next retry.Action
	type retry.Policy interface
		method Decide(retry.Attempt) retry.Decision
	type retry.PolicyFunc func(retry.Attempt) retry.Decision
		method (T) Decide(a retry.Attempt) retry.Decision
	type retry.Safe struct
		field MaxAttempts int
		method (T) Decide(a retry.Attempt) retry.Decision
	const retry.Same retry.Action
	const retry.Stop retry.Action
